subject: HackTogether 2026 - community credits grant request
messages:
From: HackTogether Grants <grants@hacktogether.org>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: HackTogether 2026 - community credits request

Hi Stephanie,

Hope you’re well — I run the grants program for HackTogether (May 31–Jun 2, 2026). We run a community track for open-source maintainers and want to provide compute credits to: (a) 10 maintainer teams (to help triage issues + demos) and (b) the top 20 winning teams for the event. Historically teams use hosted inference to prototype.

Can Redwood provide a mix of hosted credits and short trial extensions? Ballpark request: 500k tokens of hosted credits + 20 trial-extension vouchers (3 months) for winners; maintainers would get a pooled 100k token allowance split among them. We also ask for a short quote and logo permission for event materials.

Attached: HackTogether_Sponsorship_Guidelines.pdf (program details). Do you need more info about expected usage? We’re a nonprofit and this helps a lot for maintainer participation.

Thanks,
Maya Lin
Grants Program Manager
HackTogether

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: HackTogether 2026 - community credits request

Laura / Marcus — forwarding the request from HackTogether. They ask for 500k hosted tokens + 20 trial extensions + a small maintainer pool.

Notes / questions:
- We’ve supported similar events but usually cap per-team usage and require credits be for hosted API only (no private deployments).
- Would prefer to split as: 300k hosted credits for event projects + 200k reserved for maintainer pool + 20 trial vouchers (3 months) to winners. That keeps our costs manageable and shows strong support.
- Marcus, can ops generate voucher codes and a short grant agreement?
- Laura, can you okay the numbers or do we escalate to finance?

Thanks — happy to draft the outbound.

— Stephanie
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HackTogether 2026 - community credits request

Syncing ops/finance input.

Stephanie — we can do the split you suggested with some constraints:
- Allocation: 300,000 hosted-token credits (event pool) + 200,000 hosted-token maintainer pool (tokens are consumed on Redwood hosted API only).
- 20 winner vouchers will each map to a 3-month trial extension (voucher code). Each voucher caps at 25k tokens.
- Expiration: credits and vouchers expire 2026-09-30.
- Abuse control: caps per API key and usage alerts; we recommend applying event-specific metadata so we can monitor.

I’ve drafted a short grant agreement (grant_agreement_steph_20260530.pdf) that binds the promo code terms and CV/usage reporting. Finance prefers we publish a HubSpot deal (HT-2026-77) and have HackTogether sign the agreement if they want the pooled maintainer allocation (for audit). If they decline signing, we can still issue a smaller, non-contractual offer: 250k event credits + 100k maintainer pool.

Logistics: I can generate the voucher codes and the promo code name: promo_pool_HT2026. Marcus (ops) will send codes and a one-page how-to.

Attaching Sponsorship Guidelines.

— Marcus
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HackTogether 2026 - community credits request

I approve the proposed split with these clarifications:
- Cap per team: max 50k tokens/session and a hard cap of 100k tokens per team to limit long-running batch jobs. Ops to enforce via API-key throttling.
- Maintainers: explicitly reserve 50k tokens for OpenLedger Maintainers (maintainers@openledger.org) separate from the general maintainer pool — we want to ensure the steward teams can shadow & triage.
- Documentation: include a short paragraph in the grant agreement requiring a post-event usage summary (simple CSV) for our records.

Once Marcus generates codes and the agreement, Stephanie, please send the formal confirmation to HackTogether. Good to provide the marketing team a one-line quote (I’ll draft if needed).

— Laura
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: HackTogether Grants <grants@hacktogether.org>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, OpenLedger Maintainers <maintainers@openledger.org>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: HackTogether 2026 - community credits request (approved)

Hi Maya — great to meet you and congrats on the event!

Redwood is pleased to provide the following support for HackTogether 2026:
- Event pool: 300,000 hosted-token credits (promo code: promo_pool_HT2026) for participating teams; per-team soft cap 50k tokens, hard cap 100k tokens.
- Maintainer pool: 200,000 hosted-token credits (split dynamically; 50k reserved for OpenLedger Maintainers) for project maintainers to use for triage and demos.
- Winner vouchers: 20 trial-extension vouchers (3 months each), each capped at 25k tokens.
- Expiration: All credits and vouchers expire on 2026-09-30.

We attach the grant agreement (grant_agreement_steph_20260530.pdf) — please sign the last page if you want the pooled maintainer allocation (this helps with audit/finance). If you prefer not to sign, we can still issue a smaller non-contractual package (250k event credits + 100k maintainer pool).

Next steps for you:
1) Confirm whether HackTogether will sign the agreement.
2) Send preferred logo files and a 1–2 sentence line about why you value Redwood for the event.
3) Provide the maintainer list (email addresses) for the reserved OpenLedger allocation.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HT-2026-77
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3CHTGrant

Attachments: HackTogether_Sponsorship_Guidelines.pdf, grant_agreement_steph_20260530.pdf

Looking forward — we’ll generate codes and send a voucher pack once we receive confirmation.

Best,
